name: Being Taken Advantage Of
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of being taken advantage of, urging believers to exercise both wisdom and innocence as they navigate a world filled with hostility, as Jesus instructs to be 'wise as serpents, and harmless as doves' (Matthew 10:16). Christians are called to respond to mistreatment with grace and forgiveness, exemplified by Jesus' plea for mercy on those who wronged Him (Luke 23:34), and to extend kindness even to enemies, feeding and giving drink to those who oppose them (Romans 12:20). The principle of treating others as one desires to be treated (Luke 6:31) undergirds this approach, while believers are encouraged to seek God’s wisdom generously given to all (James 1:5) to discern how to live in such challenging circumstances.
